dogecoin.text:
“Why is #dogecoin growing like crazy?”

Like VC, most crypto investing is simply about finding the highest-multiple-returning opportunities, not the ‘best’ projects. Doge is up 12,000% (120X) this year & has a big hype machine + @elonmusk driving it higher.

Ask VCs about FOMO.

Breaking up $BTC into Satoshis (Sats) is long overdue & critical to mass adoption. 

BUT, realistic ambitions are also important. 1 BTC = 100M Satoshis so #SatsTo1Dollar would mean 1 #Bitcoin will be worth $100M. Isn’t that just as outlandish as Dogecoin being the world currency?
